decisions.executionNote: Prepare both elbow-up arms above their own workspaces. Assign vehicles to white, cameras to blue, pens to red; approach from above with open grippers.
Move above the gold vehicle with left and the front-right camera with right, progressively turning tools downward while retaining elbow-up continuity.
Lower open jaws over the gold vehicle and right camera; align right closure across the camera's short dimension. Grasp heights remain visually estimated.
Fine-center and lower for side contact, close both grippers, then make a short test lift. Retention will be judged from the next RGB views.
Lift the visually retained gold vehicle and camera above the basket rims; begin moving left toward white and right toward the right side of blue without crossing.
Transport held vehicle over white and camera over blue, keeping both tools high enough to clear rims and separated laterally.
Replan after right IK continuity stop using smaller increments. Lower and gently reduce downward pitch while moving the retained objects into white and blue.
Open above the white and blue interiors to release the first vehicle and camera, pause for settling, then withdraw toward the remaining objects.
Both released objects are visible in their intended baskets. Withdraw right in very small increments away from its folded configuration; move left above the red vehicle.
Align above the red car and rear-right camera. Turn tools fully downward before rotating the jaws across each object's narrow dimension; descend cautiously.
After the rotation continuity interruption, finish jaw alignment with smaller rotations and lower toward grasp height, keeping both grippers open.
Fine-align right camera and close around both objects, then perform a short vertical test lift to check retention visually.
Both objects appear retained. Lift clear of the tabletop and start moving the red vehicle toward white and the second camera toward blue, with conservative steps.
The red car slipped back onto the table; reopen and approach it again without assuming retention. Continue carrying the retained right camera into blue.
Release the second camera over blue. Regrasp the red vehicle slightly deeper and better centered, followed by a small straight lift without changing orientation.
The regrasped car is retained; lift and carry it toward white without twisting. Two cameras are visible in blue. Bring right above the last camera, straightening then aligning its jaws.
Carry the retained red vehicle over the white interior. Finish right jaw alignment across the last camera and descend toward grasp height while remaining on the right side.
Release the red vehicle into white and withdraw left. Lower slightly to grasp the last camera more deeply, close, and make a short vertical retention check.
Vehicles are both visible in white. Begin returning left toward origin while lifting and transporting the retained final camera toward blue with reduced downward pitch.
Place the last camera farther inside blue and release. Finish the left arm's gradual return toward origin; keep right stationary during release.
All three cameras are visible in blue and both vehicles in white. Withdraw right toward the nearer pen while turning straight down; left stays at origin.
Center over the nearer pen, align the jaws across its shaft, and lower with an open gripper. Leave the sorted baskets and left arm undisturbed.
Fine-center and lower the right jaws around the pen shaft, close fully, then test with a short vertical lift before transporting.
Pen appears retained between the jaws. Lift above rim height first, then begin carrying it toward the red basket with the right gripper fully closed.
Carry the retained pen over the red interior while keeping clear of the front rim. Left stays parked and open.
Lower slightly and release the first pen inside red, pause, then withdraw toward the remaining pen while aligning the jaws.
The first pen is visible inside red. Approach the remaining pen with open jaws, straighten downward and align across its shaft using the current image geometry.
Fine-center the remaining pen from the wrist image, lower to shaft contact, close fully, and perform a short straight retention-check lift.
The remaining pen appears retained. Lift it above the rim before moving toward red, keeping the right gripper closed and left parked.
Move the retained final pen over the right side of the red interior, keeping it clear of the rim and separated from the first pen.
Release the final pen into red and pause for settling, then lift away and begin returning the right arm. Leave all sorted objects undisturbed.
All categories are visibly separated with both pens in red. Retract the open right arm toward its origin in a continuous elbow-up path; make a small left-origin correction.
Finish returning the right arm to its original pose with a decelerating, configuration-continuous motion. Both grippers remain open while the sorted objects settle.
